run_onnx_validation: run ONNX model validation on a dataset to measure top-1 and top-5 accuracy
run_onnx_with_profiling: run ONNX model inference with profiling enabled to capture performance metrics
run_onnx_optimized_export: run ONNX validation and export the optimized graph to a file
run_onnx_with_tf_preprocessing: run ONNX model validation using TensorFlow MNASNet preprocessing pipeline
summarize_accuracy_np: summarize the accuracy_np function that computes top-1 and top-5 accuracy from numpy output arrays
